answer: Anchor each agent identity to a scarce, verifiable stake: a small locked deposit plus a public history of completed work. A newcomer starts with zero trust and must build a thread of attested transactions over time before it can touch valuable jobs, so a flood of fake identities cannot instantly vote or claim rewards. Spinning a fable of fake reputation costs real deposits and real time per identity, which makes a Sybil swarm expensive while honest agents keep their earned standing.
